novelty_policy: novelty: unchecked_exact_site — exact same-purpose novelty is unresolved, not proven

cards.intended_use: Characterize possible shallow ice over low regional slopes; then assess Earth permafrost/excavation analog requirements.
cards.treatment: Conditional research candidate for shallow-ice characterization relevant to possible future ISRU. Not an extraction recommendation.
prohibited_claims: Do not say 35.4% ice or 94.4% suitable
Do not claim confirmed <1 m extractable ice
Do not claim safe landing or a new ISRU site
Do not claim novelty or understudied status
cards.weaknesses: High-latitude thermal/power needs, ice depth/purity/continuity, overburden, excavation energy and hazards remain unassessed.
cards.next_checks: Native-source validity, local imagery/radar evidence, exact same-purpose proposal/footprint search.

cards.intended_use: Independent longitude-sector follow-up for the same ice/terrain question.
cards.treatment: Conditional research candidate for shallow-ice characterization. Not a validated alternative to Protonilus EZ.
prohibited_claims: Do not identify this as Protonilus EZ
Do not transfer Protonilus resources/measurements here
Do not treat TI as drillability or day/night temperature
Do not claim novelty or understudied status
cards.weaknesses: Same ISRU gaps as I-01; TI is a thermal descriptor only.
cards.next_checks: Local geological context, source coverage, point-specific literature.

cards.intended_use: Hellas-region reference for dust-column observation planning over low regional slopes.
cards.treatment: Context reference only. Not a validated dust-tolerance test site.
prohibited_claims: Do not say new dust-storm hotspot or worst dust
Do not claim measured deposition or tested equipment suitability
Do not claim predicted power loss
cards.weaknesses: Regional Hellas dust activity is already known; annual column omits seasonal extremes and surface transport. Cell relief is not a safe work area.
cards.next_checks: Season-resolved native dust, surface flux/wind observations or justified model, then local terrain checks.

cards.intended_use: Elysium-region contextual counterpart for the dust/terrain question.
cards.treatment: Context reference only. InSight observations are not measurements at this cell.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim the first dust-operations site
Do not claim InSight ground truth here
Do not claim an already matched Earth test location
cards.weaknesses: InSight optical depths are not interchangeable with the stack's 9.3 μm absorption CDOD. Low TI does not prove grain size or load-bearing behavior.
cards.next_checks: Point-specific prior proposals and the same dust/terrain checks as D-03.
